sloka: सा ज्वलन्तीव रोषेण दहन्तीव निशाचरम् ।उवाचाग्निं समाधाय मरणाय कृतत्वरा ।। ७.१७.२९ ॥
transliteration: sā jvalantīva roṣeṇa dahantīva niśācaram ।uvācāgniṁ samādhāya maraṇāya kṛtatvarā ।। 7.17.29 ॥

translations.english: Then, enraged Vedavati cut off her hair with her hand, which, having transformed into a sword, severed her locks.
